note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a CAM 24, 25; A06b CAM 24, 25; L05 CAM 31(a)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Cameroon, 2024
sources.said: Person has been habitually resident for 5 years preceding the application. ... n.a. ... Person is an adult who acquires another citizenship.
